property_summary: For any caller, setOwner succeeds only when the caller is the current owner; the buggy version makes every non-owner caller succeed (and the real owner revert), so ownership can be changed by an arbitrary address.

For any caller, c.owner() changes only if that caller was already the owner (a non-owner's setOwner leaves owner untouched); the mutant grants setOwner to anyone, so an arbitrary non-owner caller changes the owner, violating the rule.

The current owner can always transfer ownership to any address in a single call (after the owner's setOwner(x), c.owner() == x for the fuzzed x); the mutant reverts on the owner's own call, so c.owner() stays unchanged and the rule fails.
